# pangolin_blueprints (Data Source)

Lists every blueprint audit record for the organization.

Blueprints are an append-only log of past `PUT /org/{org}/blueprint` applies (auto-named with Pangolin's pet-name generator). There is no DELETE endpoint — every record persists. Use this data source for audit reporting or to fetch the latest entry by `id` for inspection via `pangolin_blueprint`.

> **Note:** `created_at` is epoch **seconds** on this endpoint, distinct from the milliseconds used elsewhere in the Pangolin API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_blueprints" "all" {}

# Most recent N applies by created_at (epoch seconds).
output "recent_apply_audit" {
  value = slice(
    reverse(sort([
      for b in data.pangolin_blueprints.all.blueprints : b.created_at
    ])),
    0, min(10, length(data.pangolin_blueprints.all.blueprints))
  )
}

# Failed applies — useful for alerting on broken IaC pushes.
output "failed_applies" {
  value = [
    for b in data.pangolin_blueprints.all.blueprints : {
      id   = b.id
      name = b.name
    } if !b.succeeded
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `blueprints` (Attributes List) List of blueprint records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blueprints))

<a id="nestedatt--blueprints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `blueprints`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp (epoch **seconds**).
- `id` (Number) Numeric blueprint ID.
- `name` (String) Auto-generated pet-name identifier.
- `org_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `source` (String) Where the apply came from. Observed: `API`, `UI`.
- `succeeded` (Boolean) Whether the apply succeeded.
